recommendation: Tail is 24, one point above the previous assessment and still one point below the block threshold. Yields and implied volatility both set fresh session highs through the 17:00Z auction window, but the 30,353.88 session low has held for roughly three and a half hours and oil has eased from its high, so the observed path continues to permit mean reversion. The mapped state is a caution state rather than a blocking one, and existing-position management and protective handling are unaffected by it. headline: NQ holds its post-PMI low for a fourth hour while the 10-year and VIX both print fresh session highs
body: The 13:45Z flash PMI (composite 58.4 against 55.2 consensus) continues to drive a hawkish rate repricing rather than a growth rally, and the rate leg of that move has extended over the past hour. At 17:26Z NDX trades 30,389.29, down 1.12%, against a 30,706.23 open that is also the session high and a 30,353.88 low that has now stood for about three and a half hours through a full bounce-and-fade cycle. NQ futures show the same shape at 30,679.50 with a 30,643.25 low. The decisive structural fact remains that neither the index nor the futures contract has made a new low since early in the cash session: mean reversion is still functioning, which is precisely what Tail measures. The amplifier stack, however, firmed through the 17:00Z five-year auction window. The 10-year yield is 5.12%, having printed a fresh 5.13 session high and the highest level since 2007, with the 2-year near 4.93%, about 18 basis points higher on the day. VIX has pushed to a session-high 15.41, up 8.45%, having been 14.84 an hour earlier. Fed Governor Barr said further policy adjustments are likely to be needed and October hike pricing sits near 70%. Semiconductors remain the weakest index leg, with SOX down 1.93% at 12,445.24, though it too holds above its 12,371.37 session low. One amplifier has eased: WTI has come back to $91.30, up 0.86%, from a $92.89 session high, trimming the inflation-side impulse that had reinforced the same repricing. The result is a genuine divergence: rates and implied volatility are at session extremes while price is not. That compression is what keeps Stress at 56, the highest reading of the week, while Tail rises only one point to 24 and stays inside the watch band, because the persistent no-retracement path that Tail measures has not appeared. Shared Finviz cross-asset context refreshed at 17:30Z, within the freshness threshold, though its futures and calendar sections were again unavailable. As delayed latest-session context rather than live price-path evidence it was used only for confirmation: all seven tracked semiconductors are lower, averaging -2.0%, which matches the live SOX print, while sector breadth has broadened lower. Megacaps are split, however, with META up 1.35% and MSFT up 0.26% against GOOGL down 3.63% and AMZN down 2.70%. That dispersion is the signature of rotation rather than index-level one-way structure, and under the calibration used here conflicting cross-asset evidence raises Stress rather than Tail. Mapped policy state: WATCH.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 hours divide cleanly at the 13:45Z flash PMI. From the 17:00Z hour on 22 September through 11:00Z today, Tail held between 10 and 21 in a quiet regime that shifted from trend-up during the prior US session to normal overnight, with Stress easing from the low-40s to the low-30s. Conditions firmed from 12:00Z as mode turned mixed, the 14:00Z hour recorded the break with Tail 25, Stress 54 and dominant mode trend-down, and the 15:00Z and 16:00Z hours stepped back to Tail 22 and 23 as the first retracement held. All 24 slots are drawn from previously published Claude assessments and none has been restated with later information.
outlookSummary: The near-term path turns on whether the 30,353.88 session low continues to hold now that yields and VIX have made fresh highs against it. Tail is carried at 24 through the final two cash hours and the closing-auction window, then steps down through the 20:00Z cash close as the intraday imbalance mechanism is removed. Overnight conditional Tail settles in the low teens with dominant mode normal, before rising again into Thursday's 12:30Z jobless claims, the 13:30Z cash open and the 14:00Z first full cash hour, where any second rate-driven impulse would first become visible. Apart from the current clock-hour, none of this structure is observed; every later slot is stated conditionally.
